description: This file contains unit tests for ElasticSearch installation and configuration within the SuiteCRM system. It verifies the presence of specific hooks and configuration settings related to ElasticSearch.

classes.name: ElasticSearchInstallTest
classes.description: Unit test class extending SearchTestAbstract to verify ElasticSearch hooks and config.

methods.name: testHooksPresent
methods.description: Tests that the after_save and after_delete hooks for ElasticSearchIndexer are correctly loaded.

methods.name: testConfigPresent
methods.description: Checks that the ElasticSearch configuration settings are present in the global configuration array.
